description: Fatemeh Jalayer and Hossein Ebrahimian publish a Jupyter workflow for tsunami vulnerability through fragility-consequence convolution. This deterministic-consequence version is freely downloadable from Zenodo and GitHub under GPL-3.0-only. The repository README describes damage-state probabilities aligned to an intensity grid in NPZ inputs, sample tables, helper functions and interactive plots. Calculations combine those probabilities with fixed consequence values for each damage state. Outputs can supply loss relationships for infrastructure tsunami-risk simulations and represent fragility uncertainty conditional on fixed consequences. Geographic coverage is generic, and the sample building class does not establish transferability to other construction types. Exact consequence calibration and numerical correctness remain unverified. The existing ETRiS building-risk model is related but does not explicitly cover this separate notebook. The alternative consequence variant uses a different assumption and has its own record. No archive was downloaded or notebook executed.
